name: How long does it take to replace a sliding door screen?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace a sliding door screen?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to replace a sliding door screen typically depends on the size and type of the screen. For a standard sliding door, the replacement process can often be completed within 1 to 2 hours if the frame is in good condition. If the frame needs repair or replacement, or if custom sizing is required, the project may take longer. Most professionals can provide an estimated timeline after an initial assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacing a standard sliding door screen usually takes 1 to 2 hours, assuming the frame is in good condition.
